recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take with meals
single_dose: adults 800mg to 1600mg three times daily || adults average dose 2.4g per meal || adults maximum dose 13g per day
mechanism_of_action: binds phosphate in the gut, reducing absorption and lowering serum phosphorus levels
side_effects: itching || joint pain || constipation || diarrhea || nausea || muscle weakness || appetite loss || bloating || stomach pain || bloody and tarry stool || choking || severe constipation || trouble swallowing
unsuitable_population: allergies to any of the ingredients in Renagel medication || bowel obstruction, severe constipation or intestinal blockage || recently undergone abdominal or stomach surgery or have problems in both areas || slow digestion
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || protect from light
